options.name: arrowParens
options.description: Include parentheses around a sole arrow function parameter.

choices.description: Omit parens when possible. Example: `x => x`

options.name: bracketSameLine
options.description: Put > of opening tags on the last line instead of on a new line.

options.name: bracketSpacing
options.description: Print spaces between brackets.
options.oppositeDescription: Do not print spaces between brackets.

options.name: cursorOffset
options.description:
Print (to stderr) where a cursor at the given position would move to after formatting.
This option cannot be used with --range-start and --range-end.

options.name: embeddedLanguageFormatting
options.description: Control how Prettier formats quoted code embedded in the file.

choices.description: Format embedded code if Prettier can automatically identify it.

options.name: endOfLine
options.description: Which end of line characters to apply.

choices.description: Line Feed only (\n), common on Linux and macOS as well as inside git repos
Carriage Return + Line Feed characters (\r\n), common on Windows
Carriage Return character only (\r), used very rarely

Maintain existing
(mixed values within one file are normalised by looking at what's used after the first line)

options.name: filepath
options.description: Specify the input filepath. This will be used to do parser inference.
options.cliDescription: Path to the file to pretend that stdin comes from.

options.name: htmlWhitespaceSensitivity
options.description: How to handle whitespaces in HTML.

choices.description: Respect the default value of CSS display property.

options.name: insertPragma
options.description: Insert @format pragma into file's first docblock comment.

options.name: jsxBracketSameLine
options.description: Put > on the last line instead of at a new line.

options.name: jsxSingleQuote
options.description: Use single quotes in JSX.

options.name: parser
options.description: Which parser to use.

options.name: pluginSearchDirs
options.description:
Custom directory that contains prettier plugins in node_modules subdirectory.
Overrides default behavior when plugins are searched relatively to the location of Prettier.
Multiple values are accepted.

options.name: plugins
options.description: Add a plugin. Multiple plugins can be passed as separate `--plugin`s.

options.name: printWidth
options.description: The line length where Prettier will try wrap.

options.name: proseWrap
options.description: How to wrap prose.

choices.description: Wrap prose if it exceeds the print width.

options.name: quoteProps
options.description: Change when properties in objects are quoted.

choices.description: Only add quotes around object properties where required.
If at least one property in an object requires quotes, quote all properties.
Respect the input use of quotes in object properties.

options.name: rangeEnd
options.description:
Format code ending at a given character offset (exclusive).
The range will extend forwards to the end of the selected statement.
This option cannot be used with --cursor-offset.

options.name: rangeStart
options.description:
Format code starting at a given character offset.
The range will extend backwards to the start of the first line containing the selected statement.
This option cannot be used with --cursor-offset.

options.name: requirePragma
options.description:
Require either '@prettier' or '@format' to be present in the file's first docblock comment
in order for it to be formatted.

options.name: semi
options.description: Print semicolons.
options.oppositeDescription: Do not print semicolons, except at the beginning of lines which may need them.

options.name: singleAttributePerLine
options.description: Enforce single attribute per line in HTML, Vue and JSX.

options.name: singleQuote
options.description: Use single quotes instead of double quotes.

options.name: tabWidth
options.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

options.name: trailingComma
options.description: Print trailing commas wherever possible when multi-line.

choices.description: Trailing commas where valid in ES5 (objects, arrays, etc.)
Trailing commas wherever possible (including function arguments).

options.name: useTabs
options.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces.

options.name: vueIndentScriptAndStyle
options.description: Indent script and style tags in Vue files.
